comment: (A) AN ORDINARY LAND'S QUEUE POSITION IS ITS TIMING (USER 2026-10-22: 'The viewer should use exactly the order I give.'). T2, one untapped Mountain, hand Mountain + Sol Ring; the human queues 'cast Sol Ring, then play the Mountain'. Before: burn offers no positioned land line, so the viewer wrote `land=Mountain` and the engine played the Mountain FIRST whatever the queue said (a `landafter=` line did not even validate -- no plan had that position). Now the line validates (CheckLine matches a legal, un-enumerated land position against the land-first plan) and the "**" pin plays the land as step 2, after Sol Ring.
